name: Everest View Trek
sub_region: Solukhumbu District, Koshi Province (Sagarmatha National Park, Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality)

difficulty.notes: Short teahouse trek staying below about 3,900 m; 4-7 hours walking a day. The Phakding-Namche climb is the steepest section. Suitable for fit first-time trekkers.

duration_days.basis: Lukla flight to Lukla flight (Kathmandu-Kathmandu flight days included); add Kathmandu arrival/buffer days
duration_days.notes: 5-day express and 8-9 day versions exist. Common variants: overnight at Khumjung instead of returning to Namche; return Tengboche-Monjo then Monjo-Lukla.

max_altitude_point: Hotel Everest View (Syangboche); highest overnight Tengboche 3,860 m
start_point: Kathmandu (fly to Lukla, or via Manthali/Ramechhap in peak seasons)

itinerary.route: Namche - Syangboche - Hotel Everest View - Khumjung - Namche
itinerary.notes: Acclimatisation hike; Hillary school and Khumjung monastery.
Tengboche Monastery; Everest and Ama Dablam views.

itinerary.route: Lukla - Kathmandu (flight; or Lukla - Manthali + 4-5 h drive)
itinerary.notes: Keep at least one spare day before international departure.

best_seasons.notes: Lower altitude makes winter more feasible than on EBC; monsoon cloud hides views and disrupts flights.

permits.name: Sagarmatha National Park entry permit
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,500; under 10 free)

permits.name: Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality Trek-Card
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person (SAARC and Chinese nationals NPR 2,000)

guide_requirements: Conflicting. NTB lists the 'Everest View trek' among routes requiring a licensed guide and TIMS card since 31 March 2023; Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality rejected the rule in April 2023 and uses its own Trek-Card. 2026 enforcement UNVERIFIED.

flights: Peak-season diversion via Manthali (Ramechhap): roughly spring Chaitra-Jestha and autumn first week of Ashwin to 15 Mangsir; Manthali-Lukla about 20 min
drives: Kathmandu - Manthali about 4-5 h (operators quote up to 5-6 h) when Lukla flights are diverted
logistics.notes: Upgraded lodges available in Phakding, Namche and near Syangboche.

highlights: First views of Everest, Lhotse, Ama Dablam and Thamserku
Hotel Everest View terrace at about 3,880 m
Namche Bazaar and the Sherpa Museum
risks: Mild altitude symptoms possible at Namche and Tengboche
unverified: Hotel Everest View altitude: about 3,880 m in most sources; one operator says 3,962 m.
Current (2026) enforcement of the national licensed-guide rule in Khumbu.
